text:
maria: Heads-up — planning the quant bakeoff next week. Need quick alignment on the calibration probe mixture and where to source edge-case prompts. Target formats: FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ. Looking for heuristics for anchor examples, negative controls, and deployment-aware weighting. Anyone?

devin: +1. My high-level rule: make the calibration set mirror the deployment distribution but intentionally over-index on fragile slices. So: stratify by length, instruction vs chat, domain, and include a small adversarial bucket.

hao: Agree. Also add "latency profile" slices. For latency-sensitive customers we care about many short tokens with high sampling temp; for throughput-heavy, include long-context prompts. That helps surface KV-cache vs per-token quant behavior.

rachel: Quick checklist I use:
- anchors: 5–10 canonical QA pairs per domain (stable oracle)
- diversity probes: 40% generic web QA / 30% long-context tasks / 20% conversational / 10% adversarial or OOD
- negative controls: nonsensical inputs + repeated-token attacks to catch numeric collapse
- holdouts: 10% of prompts as unseen evals (no tuning on them)

maria: Can you share the sampling weights you mentioned? something reproducible we can paste in the eval harness.

devin: Sure, pseudocode we use in the sampler: 
```
# target_total = 5000 probes
weights = {"short_instruction": 0.25, "long_document": 0.30, "conversational": 0.20, "adversarial": 0.10, "anchors": 0.10}
for bucket, w in weights.items():
    n = int(target_total * w)
    sample_from(bucket, n, stratify_by=["length","lexical_diversity","domain"])
```
Adjust target_total based on compute budget. Keep anchors small but high-signal.

hao: One more: include counterfactual perturbations for numeric answers (swap numbers, change units) — quant often messes up low-level arithmetic tokens. Also include prefix-variants to surface brittle prompting.

rachel: Eval-bot ran a quick coverage scan yesterday and flagged gaps in finance and code-execution prompts. eval-bot: coverage_snapshot -> {"finance": 0.52, "code": 0.47, "general_qa": 0.88} :warning:

maria: Nice — let's reweight finance/code by +1.5x for this run. Also we should log per-model-profile deltas (FP8 vs GPTQ) and correlate with prompt attributes (length/tokens/type). Can someone add an analytic column to the bakeoff schema?

devin: I'll add columns: model, quant_scheme, prompt_bucket, tokens, lexical_entropy, ground_truth_type, metric_delta. Then we can do slice-by-slice delta plots.

rachel: Suggest adding a "regression anchor" tag for any prompt that shows >X% drop in accuracy under any quant scheme — we keep those in a permanent tracker for root-cause.

maria: Perfect. Action items: devin add sampler weights + scaffold in harness; rachel expand adversarial bank and tag regression anchors; hao add latency/throughput slices and numeric-perturbation generator. I'll schedule a short sync Tues to finalize. :thumbsup:
